boundary: Host-only QUIC/TLS/UDP primitives may be implemented per target. HTTP/3 framing, admission, validation, request/response logic, actor ownership policy remain .atto; never replace with Java/C#/Rust/JS stdlib classes.

resource_handle.interpretation: Opaque per-actor handle containing table index and generation; layout private to host adapter
rules: No shared mutable buffer alias across actors
Closed and cancelled handles fail E_CLOSED
All owned handles retired before actor arena teardown
No raw pointer escape across await or to another actor

operations.name: quic_client_connect_async
operations.require: TLS1.3 certificate validation, ALPN h3, QUIC transport negotiation

operations.name: quic_server_listen_async
operations.require: Authorized UDP bind; no wildcard default; TLS identity loaded securely

operations.name: quic_accept_async
operations.require: Actor quota and handshake resource limit

operations.name: quic_open_bidi_stream_async
operations.require: Peer stream limit and actor quota

operations.name: quic_stream_read_async
operations.require: Bounded receive and actor-owned returned bytes

operations.name: quic_stream_write_async
operations.require: Progress, cancellation and partial-write semantics; no unpinned borrowed buffers

operations.name: quic_datagram_send_async
operations.require: Explicit negotiated datagram support, peer max, congestion and path MTU

operations.name: quic_negotiated_capabilities
operations.require: Authoritative ALPN, version, datagram and HTTP3 SETTINGS from live handshake; never caller-selected bools

hardening.permissions: Deno-like permission model using flags-2-env; net/UDP/TLS/listen capabilities enforced at host boundary
hardening.tls: TLS 1.3, authenticated peer validation, exact ALPN 'h3', no insecure fallback, no shared session tickets across trust domains
hardening.zero_rtt: Off by default; requires explicit opt-in and replay-safety evidence; no retry of unsafe requests
hardening.actor: Actor-owned handles, no cross-actor synchronous call, stream and connection quotas; supervisor CONTROL fault path; cancellation propagates
hardening.backpressure: Bounded actor mailbox/connection/stream buffers; QUIC flow control governs reads and writes
hardening.body: HTTP3 framing and QPACK validation in .atto, application body streaming bounded by configured policies
hardening.native_aot: Closed-world static ABI imports; engine linked into Native AOT artifact, not runtime JIT-loaded
hardening.browser_wasm: No raw UDP socket or listen by default; use supported fetch/WebTransport host capabilities; report E_UNSUPPORTED when guarantees unavailable

evidence_boundaries: Source byte identity only verifies identical Atto text, never backend semantic parity
Rust compiler -> Wasm guest pure codec tests do not verify QUIC, TLS or HTTP3 networking
Full AOT and zero/minimal GC status requires actual target-specific execution and memory measurements
No merge or release claim until independent QUIC/HTTP3 client/server interoperability with verified certificates and failure cases
